groups.name: Mary Our Queen Rosary Guild
groups.description: A men, women, and children’s group that makes rosaries for Baptisms, Confirmations, new parishioners, and others.

groups.name: Prayer Line
groups.description: An organized prayer group of individuals praying for fellow parishioners and their requested intentions.

groups.name: Prayer and Bible Study
groups.description: Prayer is the place of refuge for every worry, a foundation for cheerfulness, a source of constant happiness, a protection against sadness.

groups.name: Small Faith Groups
groups.description: Separate men’s and women’s groups that meet on Friday mornings to discuss faith and scripture. Men meet before morning Mass. Women meet after.

groups.name: Outreach Ministry
groups.description: Hosts the annual Advent Giving Tree, prepares gift boxes for Baptisms, and various other projects.

groups.name: Prayer Shawl Ministry
groups.description: Crochet prayer shawls to be used for the sick and those needing healing.

groups.name: Children's Choir
groups.description: Children’s Choir is open to grades 3 through 8. Singers rehearse on Monday afternoons and sing at the 10 AM Sunday Mass twice each month.

groups.name: Knights Choir
groups.description: The Knights Choir is open to men of the parish, even those who are not members of the Knights of Columbus. Singers rehearse on Sunday morning immediately before Mass and sing at the 8 am Mass on the fourth Sunday…

groups.name: Knights of Columbus
groups.description: The Fr. John V. Wallace Knights Council #10047 at St. Patrick here in Gretna is for Catholic men ages 18 years+. The Knights fulfill a number of duties and put on various events at our parish.

groups.name: Funeral Ministry
groups.description: Provides support with funeral wakes and liturgies, food and service for lunches, and other funeral duties.

groups.name: 55+ Club
groups.description: Individuals 55+ years old that gather for breakfast the 3rd Wednesday of the month to socialize and share fellowship.

groups.name: Lay Ministry
groups.description: Lay ministry for adults or those confirmed includes lectoring, assisting as an Extraordinary Minister of Holy Communion (EMHC), and being an usher or greeter. Families may sign up to be gift bearers, and youth in grades 4th and older may…

groups.name: Purgatorial Society
groups.description: Join a group that is dedicated to praying daily for the Holy Souls in Purgatory. No dues, no meetings, no commitment other than to pray the St. Gertrude Prayer daily.

groups.name: St. Monica Guild
groups.description: Women’s guild that assists in the laundering of the Purificators, and serving events as needed.

groups.name: St. Rose of Lima Guild
groups.description: Decorates the church with liturgically appropriate flowers and decorations throughout the year.
